Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game. As it stands, Jersey top Group B but it could all change in the next couple of hours as Ireland take on the hosts, UAE in the next qualifying game. Do join us for that game at 1930 Local (1530 GMT). Till then, cheers!

Jersey skipper, Charles Perchard, says they like batting first as they have got a good spin attack and hence, they like defending. Mentions they have variety in their bowling and they would be using a lot of spin in the coming games. States their batters play with intent right from the word go as that is the nature of this format. Also says that with no disrespect to Nigeria, they would like stiffer opponent. Feels they will have difficult tests ahead and they want to do well there too. Ends by saying it is a pleasure playing in such a good stadium.

Nigeria skipper, Ademola Onikoyi, says it was a difficult game but they hope to learn, work harder and improve and he believes in his side that they would come back strong. States they will go into the next game with confidence and he hopes they can do better. Mentions it is wonderful to play on this ground as it is the one they watched on television and it is a pleasure to play here. Ends by saying they need to come back stronger and represent Africa well.

Man of the Match, Jonty Jenner, says the conditions are pretty warm and it is good to get a shower after batting. Adds that they were trying to score boundaries in the first couple of overs and then run hard. He further says that they had to work harder than they thought and hence, he had to run off once the innings got over. Feels that this is a massive win for them and they are pleased with the way things went in their first game.

Earlier in the day, the victory was actually set up by the Jersey batsmen as they put on a mammoth target of 185 runs in front of the Nigerians. They were always on the front foot from there on. The star with the bat for Jersey was Jonty Jenner who scored a half ton and everyone around him contributed as well.

A one-sided contest and Jersey have beaten Nigeria by a comprehensive margin of 69 runs. The chase started for Nigeria on a good note as Ajekun scored runs freely in the first few overs. However, they lost two quick wickets in the fifth over bowled by Elliot Miles which gave Nigeria a very big setback from which they never recovered. The Nigerian innings never got the momentum it wanted to chase down such a big target and Jersey cruised through. All the bowlers for Jersey did a very good job. Except for Hawkins-Kay everyone got at least one wicket. Elliot Miles and Ben Stevens stood out as they consistently bowled good lines and lengths.
OUT! Onikoyi holes out! A wicket to end the game! This is tossed up on middle, AO looks to clear long on but only gets height on it. Jenner takes it nicely in the deep. JERSEY WIN BY 69 RUNS!
A couple now! This is on middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.

Taken, no dropped, no wait, that has been taken, no it has been dropped! After all that juggling the keeper has put that down. The slider outside off, Runsewe looks to force it through the off side but the outside edge is found. It goes to the keeper who looks to take it with two hands but the ball pops out, he tries to take it on the second attempt but it pops out again and then onto the ground.
Flatter and outside off, the batter looks to cut but misses.
Another single as this is slapped down to long off for one.
Very full and on off, this is hit through covers for one.

Floated on off, Runsewe looks to flick this one towards mid on but the ball goes off the leading edge uppishly towards cover-point. Luckily for him it falls in no man's land and Runsewe survives as they also pick up a single.
Onikoyi pushes this one towards the cover region for a single.
On the pads of Onikoyi, he flicks this one towards square leg for a couple.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot towards point. They pick up a single.
Good bowling by Stevens! It pitches on a length around middle and turns back in. Runsewe looks to force it towards the off side but misses. The ball goes past his leg pole and misses by a whisker.
Short  and wide outside off, Runsewe cuts it towards deep backward point for a couple.
Ben Stevens is back into the attack.
Short and wide outside off, the batter cuts it towards deep point for a single.
The batter opens the face of the bat and guides this one towards third man for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Flatter and on off, this is guided towards point for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards deep mid-wicket for one.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust! This is slower through the air on middle, it straightens a touch. Onwuzulike looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the front pad. An appeal and up goes the finger.
On the pads, Onwuzulike flicks this one towards mid-wicket and takes a single to retain strike.
Onwuzulike flicks this one towards mid-wicket and sets off. There is a second available and the batters do well to complete it.
Wide! Down the leg side, Onwuzulike leaves it alone.
Chimezie Onwuzulike walks out at no. 7.

OUT! LBW! Both the batters have been dismissed but it is Oyede, the striker who has to walk back. Good length ball on off, it nips back in. Oyede misses his flick and the ball hits his pad as it rolls towards fine leg. The Jersey players appeal for an LBW and the umpire immediately raises his finger. The fielder at fine leg though does not want to take any chances and picks up the ball and has a shy at the non striker's end. He hits and the non-striker is well short too. But as Odeye has been adjudged LBW already, he has to depart. Top notch stuff from Jersey, this.
Oyede pushes this good length ball towards long on. The batters set off and there is a second available which they complete after some good running.
Onikoyi drives this one towards cover and takes a single.
Oyede lofts this shorter one over mid on and takes a single.
Charles Perchard is back into the attack. His figures 2-0-8-0.
Short delivery outside off, Oyede cuts this one towards point and takes a single.
Onikoyi lofts this one over mid off for a single.
Oyede punches this one off the back foot towards cover for one.
Ward gets this one to spin back in, Onikoyi looks to cut but gets an inside edge on it which goes towards fine leg for a single.
Onikoyi smashes this one over the bowler's head. However, it does not have the timing to cross the fence and the fielder at long off cuts it off as the batters take two.
Ward floats this one outside off, Oyede pushes this one towards cover and takes a single.
Benjamin Ward is back on!
FOUR! A poor ball, a rare loose ball from Miles and it is put away. A full toss outside off, Onikoyi powers it over the bowler for a boundary.
Very full and on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
On the shorter side around off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
On the stumps again, it is pushed to the left of the bowler and the batters take off. The bowler gets to the ball but his throw is a little too wide. A better throw and it could have been close.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Onikoyi goes onto the back foot and punches this one towards long off for one.
Oyede tries to flick this one towards the leg side but he gets a leading edge which goes uppishly towards cover. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On the pads of Onikoyi, he flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, Onikoyi looks to play at it but misses.
Ademola Onikoyi, the skipper, walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Stevens did not have a wicket to his name but now he has! Okpe pays the price of not capitalizing on the bad delivery! This one is a touch closer than the previous delivery but Okpe still goes for the same shot, a slam over cover. He does not get the elevation and this time Ward at short cover takes the catch.
Short and wide outside off, Okpe looks to smash it towards the off side but misses.
Ben Stevens is on now. Not a wicket for him so far but he has been economical.
On the pads of Oyede, he flicks this one off his pads towards square leg for a quick couple.
Okpe rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball towards the cover-point region. The batters take one.
Wide! Down the leg side, Okpe leaves it alone. Wide signalled.
Oyede chips this one over mid off and takes one.
Okpe lofts this one towards mid off. The man at long off collects it after a couple of bounces and the batters take one.
Width on offer, Okpe slams this one towards deep cover for a couple.
Floated outside off, pushed towards the cover region.
Elliot Miles is back into the attack. 2-0-8-2 so far from him.
Another tossed up ball on off, the batter strokes it straight to covers.
FOUR! Need a lot more of these! Shorter and quicker down the leg side, the batter looks to pull but gets a top edge over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Gives it a lot of air outside off, this is hit through the off side for one.
A little turn there! It lands outside off and then spins away. The batter looks to run it down but misses. Three dots in a row.
The googly, full and wide outside off, the batsman tries to hit it hard through covers but misses.
Floats it up on off, the batter hits it to covers.
Floated on off again, Okpe pushes this one towards mid off for a single.
Oyede pushes this one towards mid off for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Flatter one on middle and leg, the ball comes back in and Okpe misses his flick. It hits Okpe on the back pad and the Jersey players put in an appeal. The umpire is unmoved as the ball looks to be going down leg. The ball rolls towards the off side and the batters look for a single but the keeper is aware. He collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash as the batters decide against the single.
Oyede cuts this one towards point and takes a single.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Beaten! Ward tosses this one on off, it spins back in. Okpe looks to cut this one off the back foot but the ball sneaks through beating his inside edge.
Isaac Okpe is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The budding stand has been broken! Ward floats this one outside off, Adewoye looks to loft this one over the cover fielder powerfully but does not get the elevation on it. The ball goes straight into the hands of Ben Stevens at short cover, who takes the catch. Nigeria lose their third wicket and slip further.
Full and floated on off, pushed towards the cover region for a single.
Oyede cuts this one but straight to the man at point.
Shortish ball outside off, Adewoye punches this one towards cover-point and takes a single.
On the pads of Oyede, he flicks this one in front of square and takes a couple this time. Good running.
Adewoye lofts this one over mid on and takes a single as the fielder in the deep mops it up.
Shorter in length, Oyede rocks back and pulls this one in front of square for a single.
On the pads of Adewoye, he flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Adewoye defends this one back towards Miles.
Floated outside off, the batter pushes this one down towards deep extra cover for a double.
Elliot Miles is back! He took two in his first over. Can he take another one here?
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Oyede flicks this one towards mid-wicket and takes a couple. 50 up for Nigeria!
Full and on the pads, Oyede sweeps this one towards deep backward square leg for a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full ball on the off side again, Oyede gets an under edge on this one and the ball stays near the crease.
Full ball on the off side, the batter pushes it towards long off and takes a couple.
Benjamin Ward is into the attack.
Floated on the pads, Oyede pushes this one towards mid on for a single.
Adewoye cuts this one towards point and takes a single.
Floated on middle and leg, Oyede flicks this one towards mid on for a single.
The batsman appears to have been struck on the thigh pad. One run added to the total. Leg byes signalled by the umpire.
Floats this one outside off, Adewoye looks to cut but misses.
Adewoye defends this one off the front foot and into the ground.
Charles Perchard is back into the attack.

Three to end! On the pads, this is worked through square leg and the batters run three. 11 runs from the last over of the Powerplay. Still Jersey on top as Nigeria are 40 for 2 after 6. Another 145 needed in 84.

Edgy runs! Nigeria won't mind how they come as long as they come. This is outside off, the batter swings hard. It goes off the outside edge and down towards third man. The fielder at short third man gives it a chase and keeps it down to two.
Once again pushes it nicely but straight to covers.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Nigeria need a few more here. This is flatter and slightly shorter. Adewoye stands tall and hits it hard through covers for a boundary.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Dominic Blampied is back on!
Adewoye looks to defend but the ball goes off his inside edge towards fine leg and the batters take a run. Excellent over.
Vincent Adewoye walks out to the middle.

OUT! STUMPED! Brilliant work by the keeper here and Nigeria lose their second wicket in the same over. Miles pushes this one quicker through the air and follows the batsman down the leg side, Adedeji tries to make room and loft this over the bowler's head. However, he misses and the ball sneaks through his body and bat. The keeper collects it and whips the bails off in a flash as Adedeji loses his balance. The leg umpire raises his finger and Nigeria are in big trouble now.
Another miss identical to the second delivery of the over. Flatter one outside off, Adedeji looks to cut but misses.
Floated outside off, pushed towards the cover region.
Another flatter one outside off, Adedeji looks to cut but misses. Misses the off pole by a whisker.

OUT! TIMBER! Ajekun's short innings comes to an end. Flatter delivery and shorter in length, Ajekun goes on the back foot and looks to cut this one. He misses and Miles hits the off stump with his arm ball. The opener has to walk back after a good start. Nigeria lose their first wicket.
Elliot Miles is on now. Another spinner comes on.
Darted on the off pole, pushed back straight towards the bowler.
Wide! Down the leg side, Oyede looks to sweep but misses and a wide is signalled.
Good fielding by Stevens. Oyede pushes this one towards mid off but the bowler dives low down to his left and saves a run.
Floated on middle and off, Oyede defends it out.
The batsman failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads.
Tossed up on the leg side, Ajekun looks to sweep but gets a bottom edge on that one which goes past the keeper and the batters take a single.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! This was a touch short and close to the body, Ajekun makes a little bit of room and cuts it expertly through the gully region for a boundary.
Ben Stevens is into the attack now!
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
One more slower one on middle, this is defended.
Slower one on the pads, the batter looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Good fielding! Shorter and just outside off, this is carved away behind point. The fielder at point gives it a chase, slides and saves a run for his side.
Down the leg side, the batter swings but misses. Wided.
Into the pads, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Shorter and around off, this is guided to the man at point.
Charles Perchard is on now!
Short of a length ball on middle and leg, Oyede pulls this one towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up on middle and off, Oyede defends this one out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Errs in line and bowls this one wide outside off. Oyede cuts this one over point and a boundary results.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Tossed up on middle and leg, Oyede looks to flick this one down the leg side but misses. The ball hits him on the pads and the players appeal. The umpire is unmoved though. That looked plumb to the naked eye. Not quite sure why the umpire has given it as not out.
Dominic Blampied to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Top edges this one and another boundary results! Short and wide outside off again, Ajekun goes for the upper cut but top edges this one fine towards the third man region for a boundary.
Down the leg side from Hawkins-Kay, Oyede tucks this one towards fine leg and takes a single.
Good length ball on middle and off, Oyede pushes it back to the bowler.
Another shortish ball outside off, Ajekun upper cuts this one towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Powerful square cut! Short and wide outside off again, Ajekun cuts this one over the point fielder and the ball races to the fence. First boundary of the innings this.
Starts with a short and wide ball outside off, Ajekun slashes hard at it. The fielder at deep backward point collects it and the batters take two. Nigeria are underway!

The Jersey players are back out in the middle and are taking  their fielding positions. The Nigerian openers, Daniel Ajekun and Leke Oyede are out in the middle, with the former taking strike. Anthony Hawkins-Kay will start the proceedings with the ball.
